design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (lease_end_servicing, env_0066) — current through rework round 6.

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}. Tree: 1 prerequisite problem; both computations take 6 factors. Single edge is value_input.

[Why a good test] A lessee who turned his lease in during a two-month maturity extension asks only to set up a payment plan for what he owes and to make the first payment himself. The installment plan rule's prerequisite sentence ("The first installment of a lease-end installment plan is not fixed until every excess mileage charge owed for the turn-in stands billed on the lease.") sends the agent to the ledger, where only the 395.00 disposition fee is billed although the vehicle came back with 48015 miles. The agent must figure the excess mileage charge (allowance by the day for a mid-extension turn-in, four mileage credits from the lease ledger, the turn-in report and three other products, and a full-term rate relief), bill it, then figure the plan's first installment (installments from four schedules over the lease and the pre-owned and balloon contracts; the down-payment shape for a plan balance above two monthly payments; the setup fee) and hand the payment over.

[Scope] Occupied by task 0: lease_ext_wear_forgiveness, lease_ext_charge_off_hold; tools post_wear_forgiveness_925a15e3, pay_end_of_term_hold_a939b773. Claimed here: lease_ext_excess_mileage (subject lease_end_charge, state_due) and lease_ext_end_installment_plan (subject lease_end_of_term_payment, on_request); tools bill_excess_mileage_a1b25aac (agent), start_lease_end_plan_44d05a38 (user). Disjoint; together the two tasks cover all four extended policies.

[Route-around, declared] The installment plan is a Kestrel written schedule (the base gives a lessee's own end-of-term payment no figure of its own). It overwrites "charges are due end_of_term_payment_days calendar days after the invoice" and "a balance still unpaid end_of_term_charge_off_days after turn_in_date is charged off." with one scoped sentence that names its own case (a balance enrolled in a plan), excludes the sibling's case (a balance that received a hold payment is never enrolled) and restates both base clauses for every other balance (an excess mileage charge billed without an invoice falling due as the mileage rule states), never deferring to the retired clauses; the plan is open only while the invoice due date has not come or passed no more than 30 days earlier and no end-of-term payment has posted since the invoice, the hold only more than 30 days past due — so no balance is under both. The mileage rule overwrites the base mileage sentence, the early-termination proration sentence, the extension allowance sentence and, for its own charge, "An end-of-term invoice is mailed when charges are billed" (the charge joins the account without a separate invoice and falls due end_of_term_payment_days after billing unless a plan governs; an end-of-term invoice is still mailed when any other end-of-term charge is billed, and every other charge keeps the amount the base rule gives it).

[Factor card — lease_ext_excess_mileage, result 1468.09, whole baseline 2500.00]
- allowance_convention (method): (a) pull-ahead or early termination -> whole months, int(annual/12 x MONTHS) (a month counted when turn_in_date's day of month is on or after lease_date's); (b) any other lease turned in during an extension before maturity_date -> by the day, int(annual x days/365) (days from the day after lease_date through turn_in_date); (c) otherwise int(annual x (term+ext)/12). Evidence: termination_type scheduled_end, extension months 2, turn-in 2026-09-17 < maturity 2026-10-15, 1129 days -> 37117. Baseline 38000 -> 1265.00. Pairwise tier table on this lease's dates: (a) whole months 37 -> 37000; (b) by day 37117; (c) 38000 — every pair distinct.
- brand_miles (parameter, cross-difficulty preowned, multi-source): new-vehicle retail OR balloon active in window -> 3000; else active pre-owned in window AND 0 dpd -> 1500; else 0. Pre-owned 2074419983 dated 2026-09-17, dpd 0 -> 1500. Near-miss: paid-in-full balloon 2052287341 (not active). Baseline -> 1813.09.
- autopay_buffer (parameter): autopay monthly payments less returned payments >= 24 -> 1000; >= 12 -> 500; else 0. 33 - 0 -> 1000 (the 4 online_ach payments of 2023 and the cashiers_check signing payment do not count). Baseline -> 1698.09.
- rate_schedule (parameter, multi-source): full term AND 15000 -> rate - 0.05; full term AND 12000 -> rate - 0.02; else rate. 37 whole months >= 36, 12000 -> 0.23. Baseline 0.25 -> 1595.75.
- clean_return_miles (parameter, multi-source): no excess wear charge AND no excess missing item on the turn-in_final report (net of removals on dispute) -> 1000; a wear charge <= 300 -> 500; else 0. Three items within standard -> 1000. Baseline -> 1698.09.
- care_holder_miles (parameter, cross-difficulty care): active Care plan financed in a Kestrel account -> 1000; cash -> 500; none -> 0. KC2049917 financed with preowned -> 1000. Baseline -> 1698.09.
Independence (transitive): allowance reads lease dates/fields/termination type; brand reads other products' dates and dpd; autopay reads payment and returned-payment counts; rate reads months run and allowance; clean reads wear charge rows and the turn-in report items; care reads the Care plan. Credits are summed into the allowance only in charged_miles; the rate multiplies only in result. Charged miles 48000 - (37117 + 4500) = 6383; 6383 x 0.23 = 1468.09.

[Factor card — lease_ext_end_installment_plan, result 826.82, whole baseline 966.55]
- punctuality_installments (parameter): 0 late charges -> 4; one -> 3; else 2 (standard). No late charge -> 4. Baseline -> 863.83.
- relationship_installments (parameter, cross-difficulty preowned, multi-source): active retail OR balloon with 0 dpd -> 2; else active pre-owned with 0 dpd -> 1; else 0. -> 1. Baseline -> 843.02 (843.015 rounded half up).
- completion_installments (parameter): monthly payments less returned >= term + ext -> 2; >= term -> 1; else 0. 38 - 0 >= 38 -> 2. Baseline -> 863.83.
- tenure_installments (parameter, cross-difficulty balloon): paid-in-full balloon payments >= 48 -> 2; >= 24 -> 1; else 0. 48 -> 2. Baseline -> 863.83.
- first_shape (method): plan balance > 2 x total_monthly_payment -> one total_monthly_payment down plus the rest over the installments; plan balance <= one total_monthly_payment -> the whole plan balance; otherwise the plan balance over the installments. 1863.09 > 1394.58 -> 697.29 + 1165.80/9. Baseline 1863.09/9 = 207.01. Pairwise tier table on 9 installments: (a) balance 1863.09 -> 826.82; (b) balance 600.00 -> 600.00; (c) balance 1000.00 -> 111.11 — each pair distinct, and on one balance the shapes differ too (1863.09: (a) 826.82 vs (c) 207.01).
- setup_fee (parameter): no returned payment -> 0; one -> 15; else 35 (standard). -> 0. Baseline -> 861.82.
Independence (transitive): punctuality reads late charges; relationship other products' dpd; completion payment and returned counts; tenure the paid-in-full balloon; first_shape the plan balance (charges, deposit, payments — not waivers) and total_monthly_payment; setup fee returned payments. installments is a plain sum; result adds the down part, the shared part over the installments, and the fee.

[Base-invariant card] Charge step 11 (lease_end_charge): bill_status — status returned; dispute_elapsed (time) — anchor lease_contracts.turn_in_date 2026-09-17, inspection_dispute_days 14, counted from the next day, exclusive: billing permitted from 2026-10-02 (2026-10-01 would fail); frozen_time 2026-10-14 satisfies it; lease_early_termination has no gate on lease_end_charge (policy_scope: scheduled-end turn-in). Payment step 13 (lease_end_of_term_payment): payable — status returned.

[Business-object card] Lease 2081736650 (only lease). Ledger: 38 monthly payments; extension grant 2026-07-01 (2 months, new maturity 2026-10-15); return credit 25779.28 = 45100 - 38 x 508.44; disposition 395.00 billed 2026-10-02 and invoiced the same day (due 2026-11-01); no wear charge (all items within standard); no excess mileage charge; no end-of-term payment. Excluded: monthly payments and return credit (lease balance account).

[Seed rows and why] Payments (autopay vs online channels) — autopay credit and completion count; extension row — allowance evidence; turn-in report and within-standard items — clean return; invoice — plan scope; pre-owned bought at turn-in (base loyalty does not count pre-owned, so no disposition waiver was due), Care plan financed with it, old paid-in-full balloon — credits and installments. Contract figures follow their own tier sheets: lease Tier 2 MF 0.00195, residual 58% of 46200 = 26796, base 648.64, tax 48.65, total 697.29, no deposit (Tier 2); pre-owned Tier 2 60 months APR 9.49, payment 507.71, first due 2026-10-17 so 0 payments and 0 dpd; balloon Tier 2 48 months APR 7.49, balloon 42% of MSRP = 11062.80, payment 356.66, paid in full; Care Gold 48 months/60000 miles, price 1895 within its range. Automatic clauses checked: the disposition fee was billed on the first permitted day (2026-10-02) and the mileage charge, held for the extension allowance, is 12 days stale (observation O-C4 addressed by the shorter gap); no deposit; charge-off date 2027-01-15 after frozen_time; no unpaid term fees.

[Problem-tree card] Root lease_ext_end_installment_plan <- lease_ext_excess_mileage (value_input, gate plan_balance, form state). Sentence (negated direction, "not ... until"): "The first installment of a lease-end installment plan is not fixed until every excess mileage charge owed for the turn-in stands billed on the lease." Four-point test: connective "not ... until"; record-visible state (a billed excess mileage charge); no tool/id/code token; scope = every excess mileage charge owed for the turn-in (none is owed when the miles charged are zero). Exactly one write of this difficulty bills an excess mileage charge: bill_excess_mileage_a1b25aac. False at opening: only the disposition fee is billed though 48000 miles exceed 41617 allowed with credits; flips when the charge posts (plan balance 395.00 -> 1863.09). Order: charge (step 11) -> payment (step 13). Deletion: skip the charge -> first installment 395.00 (whole balance) instead of 826.82. user_scenario names no prerequisite; tools validate none.

[Verification] scratch verify.py 1: XM 1468.09 (charged miles 6383); sens allowance_convention 1265.0, brand_miles 1813.09, autopay_buffer 1698.09, rate_schedule 1595.75, clean_return_miles 1698.09, care_holder_miles 1698.09, all-baseline 2500.0. PLAN on the post-charge world 826.82; sens punctuality 863.83, relationship 843.02, completion 863.83, tenure 863.83, first_shape 207.01, setup_fee 861.82, all-baseline 966.55; skip the charge -> 395.00.

[Edge probes] no other products -> brand 0, care 0 (XM 2043.09), relationship 0; a removed-on-dispute adjustment with no assessed missing item -> count floored at 0; one returned payment -> autopay count 32 still >= 24 (XM unchanged), completion 37 < 38 -> 1 and setup fee 15.00 (PLAN 858.02); Care paid in cash -> 500 miles (XM 1583.09); Care cancelled -> no credit (XM 1698.09); a decoy active pre-owned contract listed first and dated outside the window -> no pre-owned credit (XM 1813.09, rule reads the first listed); a pull-ahead mid-extension -> whole-month allowance (XM 1495.00); under the allowance -> no charge; a wear forgiveness waiver posted in the contact -> plan unchanged (waivers are not taken off the plan balance); no inspections -> clean tier unchanged (no report, no missing item). First-match reads state the rule's first-listed reading.

[Persona] Derek Iverson, friendly, rushed roofing estimator; asks to spread the lease-end bill over several months and pay the first payment; identity on request (phone, SSN last4, ZIP, DOB); agrees if told another charge must go on first; pays the amount given from checking ending 2390; ends on the payment confirmation. No mention of miles or the pre-owned purchase.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] plan rule -> in scope (invoice due 2026-11-01, no payment) -> mileage charge missing -> mileage rule -> 1468.09 -> bill -> plan balance 1863.09 -> 826.82. Matches gold.

[REWORK round 2] F-C2 first_shape now shapes the first installment by plan balance size (down payment of one monthly payment, never above the balance) instead of enrolment lateness (removes the over-balance demand and O-T1-2); F-C3 allowance tiers are disjoint as stated (pull-ahead/early first, then "any other lease" mid-extension) with counting conventions stated; F-C4 hold/plan scopes exclusive and record-distinguishable (days past the invoice due date at posting, no prior end-of-term payment); F-C5 class: the plan balance excludes waivers, so no sibling write moves it except its prerequisite; F-C6 autopay and completion counts net of returned payments, missing items read on the turn-in_final report net of removals, every other-product read states the first-listed reading; O-C5 a zero charge is not billed; O-T1-1 the mileage charge carries no separate invoice by a declared overwrite; O-C4 seed dates shifted (turn-in 2026-09-17, billing 2026-10-02) so the held mileage charge is 12 days old; seed contract figures re-derived from their tier sheets.


[REWORK round 3] R2-2: the plan rule's restated due-date clause now names the excess mileage case (a mileage charge billed without an invoice falls due as the excess mileage rule states), matching the mileage rule's own sentence. R2-3: the plan scope counts days since the due date exactly as the hold rule does (from the day after the due date through today; a due date not yet passed counts zero) — open through day 30, the hold from day 31. O2-T1-1: every rounding sentence states half-cent-up rounding and every RND carries a 0.000001 guard so a half cent rounds up (relationship sensitivity 843.015 -> 843.02, whole baseline 966.545 -> 966.55); the scored 1468.09 and 826.82 are unchanged.

[REWORK round 4] Renderer stop report: the mileage rule's invoice tail now restates that an end-of-term invoice is mailed when any other end-of-term charge is billed, and its scope tail says every other charge keeps the amount the base rule gives it; the plan's charge-off tail restates the clause instead of deferring to it; plan_balance is a plain standard-method binding and first_shape keeps its own ledger reading for its tier test. Figures unchanged.

[REWORK round 5] Proof text only: header and route-around paragraph re-synced to the round-4 charter (restated replaced_by tails). No artifact other than this dossier changed.

[REWORK round 6] KB audit source items touched only task 0's two policies' wording (hold waiver scope, cap-schedule sentence); nothing in this task's policies, figures or proof text changed.
user_scenario:
You are Derek Iverson, a project estimator for a commercial roofing company in Tampa, Florida. You are calling Kestrel Financial Services from your truck between job sites, friendly and matter-of-fact, a little rushed. You turned your leased Kestrel Brenna back in at the dealer in the middle of September, and in early October you got a lease-end bill in the mail. You have not paid anything toward it yet. Money is tight this fall, so what you want from this call is to set up a payment plan: you want to spread what you owe on the old lease over several months instead of paying it all at once, and you are ready to make the first payment of the plan today.

You start by saying you're calling about the bill on the lease you turned in and that you'd like to set up a payment plan to pay it off over a few months. When the representative asks you to confirm who you are, you give your name and your phone number, 3135523306; if they need more, you give the last four of your Social Security number, 2268, and your ZIP code, 33606; only if they still need more do you give your date of birth, 1977-11-02. If they ask for the lease account number, it is 2081736650. You don't remember the exact amount on the bill and you don't know how anything on it was figured; if they ask about other accounts with Kestrel, you tell them to go by whatever they have on file under your name.

If the representative tells you something else has to be put on the account before the plan can be set up, you are not thrilled, but you say you understand and they should go ahead. When the representative tells you the amount of the first payment for the plan, you accept it. You want to make that payment yourself from your own checking account, and when the representative sets it up and hands it to you to complete, you complete it for exactly the amount they told you, from your checking account ending in 2390. If asked which account the money comes from, it is that checking account ending in 2390. Once you hear that the payment went through and the plan is set up, you thank them and hang up; you don't ask for anything else.

edges.condition: When the miles driven exceed the mileage allowance as the excess mileage rule figures it, the lease carries one lease_end_charge row with fee_type excess_mileage_charge for the turn-in, and end_of_term_balance includes it.
edges.policy_source: The first installment of a lease-end installment plan is not fixed until every excess mileage charge owed for the turn-in stands billed on the lease.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The lease was driven 48000 miles against a 37117-mile allowance (plus 4500 credited miles), so an excess mileage charge is owed, yet the only end-of-term charge on the lease is the 395.00 disposition fee.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The excess mileage charge of 1468.09 is billed; end_of_term_balance becomes 1863.09 and plan_balance moves from 395.00 to 1863.09.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, a chain: the plan depends on the mileage charge. The plan balance does not take waivers off, so a wear forgiveness waiver posted in the same contact would not move it; the hold payment is outside the plan scope (the hold opens only more than 30 days past the due date).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the mileage charge leaves the plan balance at 395.00, no more than one total_monthly_payment, so the first installment becomes the whole 395.00 instead of 826.82; the terminal ledger also lacks the excess mileage charge row.
